title: Contact details, questions and class phrases (Unit 1 final)
description: Unit 1 check after lessons 5 and 6, with the unit's final writing task.

items.question: 8 am, you come into the office. What do you say to your colleagues?
items.explanation: Review (Unit 0): Guten Morgen until about 11. Hallo! is fine at work too.
Review (Unit 0): Ich verstehe nicht. With das: Ich verstehe das nicht.
German asks with wie (how), not was: Wie ist Ihre E-Mail-Adresse?

items.question: In class, the teacher uses a word you don't know. What do you ask?
items.explanation: Was bedeutet das? = What does that mean?

items.instruction: Listen and write the numbers as words.
items.explanation: Adresse has one d and a double s; Hauptstraße has ß; zwölf has ö.

items.instruction: Unit 1 final task, in two parts. Part 1: you meet a new colleague at work (use Sie). Say hello, your name, where you come from, where you live and what you do, then ask them one question. Part 2: you meet a classmate in your German course (use du). Say which languages you speak and how long you have been learning German (use one of these: 'Ich lerne seit einer Woche Deutsch', 'seit zwei Wochen', 'seit einem Monat'), then ask them two questions. Claude will check it. Then ask Claude for the live chat: Claude plays the colleague, then the classmate.
items.prompt: Introduce yourself to a new colleague (Sie) and to a classmate (du).
